issue.title: bob clipboard is registered twice: duplicate completion kinds entry and catalog entry+exclusion fail two lib tests
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Nodes:** `native::completion::kinds::tests::every_table_entry_matches_the_tree`
  and `native::catalog::tests::public_leaves_are_entries_or_excluded` (`-p bob-obsidian --lib`)
- **Observed:** `just check` on bob-cli master `723af324` (2026-11-05, athena) by the
  bob-cli-h8 land agent: lib suite `5182 passed; 2 failed`; fmt, clippy, and the CLI
  suite (3202) pass.

Failures:

- `src/native/completion/kinds.rs:996`: `stale kinds entries: ["duplicate table entry for clipboard:count"]`
- `src/native/catalog/tests.rs:132`: `path ["clipboard"] is in both lists without non-empty fixed or a url slot`

Root cause: two parallel commits each registered `bob clipboard`.
`12e36842` (bob-cli-he, counted `%c` history) and `06d6c32e` (ad-hoc agent 18x,
"repair pre-existing Clippy and clipboard integration failures") both added
`Entry { path: &["clipboard"], arg: "count", kind: Kind::FreeText }` to the kinds
`TABLE` (now at `kinds.rs:95-99` and `:545-549`). The catalog also lists `clipboard`
both as a `reads("clipboard", ...)` row in `ENTRIES` (`catalog/table.rs:1003-1010`)
and in `EXCLUDED` (`table.rs:1127-1130`, "run it from a terminal").

Fix: keep one kinds entry, and decide whether `bob clipboard` is a command-mode
catalog row or an exclusion, then drop the other. Re-run
`cargo test -p bob-obsidian --lib` and `just check`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic structural assertions over static tables (duplicate TABLE entry; path present in both ENTRIES and EXCLUDED); they fail on every run of master 723af324.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-h8 land agent's just check on master 723af324 fails two lib tests deterministically because two parallel commits each registered bob clipboard; no existing bead or active epic owns it.

payload.description: bob-cli-he's 12e36842 added one of the two duplicate clipboard registrations
Confirm existing tracker for the duplicate clipboard catalog and completion registration

evidence.note: Independent landing reproduction on 6ea08f74, triaging bob-cli-hg.3.1.3 note #1 and the duplicate clipboard subset of bob-cli-hg.3.1.4 note #2: cargo test --lib native::catalog::tests::public_leaves_are_entries_or_excluded -- --exact fails at catalog/tests.rs:132 because clipboard is in both lists; cargo test --lib native::completion::kinds::tests::every_table_entry_matches_the_tree -- --exact fails at kinds.rs:996 with duplicate clipboard:count. Same static registration defect as this task; no new task created.
